Bootstrap 6 has been rebuilt for today's web as a framework-agnostic design toolkit that anyone—human or AI, novice or pro—can use to build anything. New standards, new components, an updated visual design, CSS-first theming, and more powerful JavaScript plugins.Learn more on the blog.
